s0_s10_audit.audit_conclusion: Stages S0-S10 form a verified, reproducible CPU-native foundation for narrow controlled relational/functional/grounded learning, NOT open-world intelligence. Eight structural gaps (L01-L08) block direct open-world transfer and motivate Stage S11.0 evaluation + S11.1 design.

open_world_limitations.open_world_consequence: Without an upstream raw-observation -> evidence -> entity/event/relation extractor, S0-S10 ITL cards cannot even parse or ingest organic Wikipedia passages, causal prose, or multi-turn user dialogues.
open_world_limitations.summary: ITL operator induction assumes clean pre-segmented (before_state, action, after_state) relational state-graph tuples produced by a deterministic black-box simulator. Real-world text, documents, and multi-session dialogues do not come with explicit structured state graphs or pre-labeled action invocations.

open_world_limitations.open_world_consequence: Open-world observations introduce unbounded open-vocabulary entities, paraphrases, implicit causal links, and latent events that have no pre-registered state-delta oracle.
open_world_limitations.summary: S1 TypedStateFrame and S2/S3 OperatorCard assume a discrete finite set of typed predicates and deterministic entity-type tags per world. Even in S7 raw UTF-8 grounding, constructions are aligned strictly against already-verified discrete OperatorCard state deltas.

open_world_limitations.open_world_consequence: In passive open-world corpora (documents, conversations, commonsense narratives), the learner cannot query a noise-free world simulator to test arbitrary counterfactual actions; verification must instead rely on observational consistency, source-disjoint cross-evidence corroboration, temporal contradiction detection, and executable checks where available.
open_world_limitations.summary: S3 contrast refinement, S5 RDC dream-refutation/active querying, and S9 autonomous curriculum rely on an interactive black-box TransitionEnvironment.step() oracle that answers synthetic counterfactual queries on demand with zero noise.

open_world_limitations.open_world_consequence: Synthesizing general open-world capabilities from unstructured specifications requires expanding beyond fixed micro-DSL combinators without leaking task-specific templates.
open_world_limitations.summary: S6 achieved 19/20 on HumanEval-Micro within a compact typed combinator grammar (honestly leaving he_micro_20_count_vowels unsolved), while Mirror's external MBPP evaluation (scripts/run_five_organ_external_eval.py) remains 0/20.

open_world_limitations.open_world_consequence: Unseen lexical paraphrases, implicit world causality, pragmatic implicature, and adversarial unanswerable questions in natural prose defeat exact construction alignment.
open_world_limitations.summary: S7's 2.5649 bpb CTW+construction Byte-LM and 100% UTF-8 instruction execution hold on controlled grounded synthetic worlds where constructions map cleanly onto discrete operators, not on organic natural-language commonsense (e.g. Balanced COPA, StoryCloze) or open-domain reading comprehension (SQuAD v2).

open_world_limitations.open_world_consequence: In real multi-session memory benchmarks (LongMemEval), user facts evolve over weeks (knowledge-update), span multiple sessions (multi-session), require date arithmetic (temporal-reasoning), or are genuinely absent (_abs abstention).
open_world_limitations.summary: S1's append-only EpisodeLedger and S8's ContinualKnowledgeBase preserve verified structured skills with 99.43% retention, but neither performs temporal belief revision, multi-session coreference resolution, or contradiction tracking over raw unstructured conversational transcripts with distractor sessions.

open_world_limitations.open_world_consequence: Existing staged rule/blueprint packs cannot be promoted without independent verification and provide near-zero grounded coverage on unseen open-world instances.
open_world_limitations.summary: Staged blueprints (997 unambiguous + 17 collision clusters), general reasoning candidates (10,240 unverified + 26 source-supported with tests not_run), and 110 authored domain seeds are mostly generic textbook/prompt templates with evidence_status=unverified.

open_world_limitations.open_world_consequence: CPU time and peak heap measurements remain directly comparable across pure-CPU baselines.
open_world_limitations.summary: S10 energy numbers are analytical process-time * single-core TDP proxies, not direct hardware RAPL/PMU readings. Stage S11.0 therefore reports raw process CPU time, wall time, throughput, and tracemalloc peak heap directly without over-claiming hardware energy.
